notes.title: Recovery Phrase - New Update!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the latest updates in Recovery Phrase! We have added several new features to enhance your gaming experience:

[h2]New Achievements
[/h2]
We have added 13 new achievements waiting for you to discover and unlock:

Train Detective
Breaking Bad Discovery
Snapshot Success
Totems Solved
StarGazer
Mastermind Genius
Maze Master Librarian
SOS Success
Power Surge
Codebreaker
Matchstick Maestro
Reflective Mastery
Platform Perfectionist
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174306/b05c0e4aecf656faba63b27bdfaf823f1c9bb61a.png[/img]

[h2]Tips in Every Level[/h2]
Each level now includes a unique tip to help you through the level. Tips are available in all languages into which the game is translated.
To assist you further, we are considering adding more hints by the time to help you crack all the puzzles and unlock the wallet since we understand that our puzzles were designed to be a really difficult - which may cause some frustration then joy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174306/5ee14b0984ac97896fedf0e095316c92857e4082.png[/img]

[h2]New Feature - Camera[/h2]
We have added a camera application that allows you to take photos and view them in your notes directly within the game.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174306/3fba1b48fadc8c579ed6220ffdebba381c03562a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174306/16f34262c360d884501a2064a8baf4d57948a2ed.png[/img]

[h2]Exciting Update and Discounts[/h2]
Additionally, we are thrilled to announce that the game will be discounted very soon and the price of the game will remain very low!
New features update will be available RIGHT NOW!

[h2]Ciphered Crypto Wallet[/h2]
The current value of the ciphered crypto wallet is around [h3]$435[/h3]
Check link: [url=https://etherscan.io/address/0xab236CDf87fd06Ff981B3C799687035A7b91f4d4]Wallet address[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174306/c470f877237169896cf8b4df09e2d4e315e59ae9.jpg[/img]


Thank you for playing Recovery Phrase! We believe these new features and updates will further enrich your game experience.

[h3]**Team WeDidIT**[/h3]
